mentions.name: Whistle
mentions.description: Offline voice transcription app that runs entirely on device with no ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts, and no network access required. The Android version is available free on Google Play; macOS, Windows, and Linux builds are built and will be released as free downloads on the author's site, and the iOS build is complete pending Apple Developer signup. Built on whisper.rn and whisper.cpp.
mentions.source_excerpt: Completely free, no ads, no in-app purchases and no accounts / network required offline voice transcription.
